text: Valesa Faria, Director, Housing Policy and Strategy, Housing Secretariat will provide a presentation, outlining the mandate and work of the Housing Secretariat at the City of Toronto. The presentation will provide an overview and update of the Housing TO 2020 - 2030 Action Plan, highlighting progress to date, key priorities identified for 2024 and the role of other City Divisions and levels of government.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee received the item for information.
